2609.21863.title: AutoRecLab: Describe the Experiment, Get the Code!
2609.21863.paper_summary: Empirical evaluation is central to recommender-systems (RecSys) research, but turning experimental designs into executable code remains a manual and error-prone task. We present AutoRecLab, a Python-based autonomous RecSys lab that automates RecSys experiments from natural-language prompts. Given a research idea, AutoRecLab derives explicit experiment requirements, builds and validates a prototype, and iteratively expands it into the requested full experiment. The workflow combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for documentation lookup, static type verification, and execution-steered tree search. In our demonstration, AutoRecLab autonomously implements an explicit-to-implicit feedback conversion study. In a baseline comparison across six algorithms and three datasets, 8 of 9 runs succeed at an average cost of approx- imately $1 per run with GPT-5.4-mini.
2609.21863.paper_summary_zh: 實證評估是推薦系統（RecSys）研究的核心，但將實驗設計轉化為可執行代碼仍然是一項手動且容易出錯的任務。<lb/>我們介紹了 AutoRecLab，一個基於 Python 的自主 RecSys 實驗室，能夠從自然語言提示自動化 RecSys 實驗。<lb/>給定一個研究想法，AutoRecLab 會推導出明確的實驗要求，構建並驗證原型，並將其迭代擴展為所請求的完整實驗。<lb/>該工作流程結合了增強檢索生成（RAG）用於文檔查找、靜態類型驗證和執行引導的樹搜索。<lb/>在我們的演示中，AutoRecLab 自主實現了一項明確到隱式反饋轉換研究。<lb/>在六種算法和三個數據集的基準比較中，9 次運行中有 8 次成功，平均每次運行的成本約為 $1，使用的是 GPT-5.4-mini。
